course.title: Intro Textiles Technology
course.classification: School-developed 50-hour Stage 4 introductory elective aligned to Textiles Technology
course.project: Design and produce source-backed accessory and apparel textile projects

site.name: Stage 4 Textiles Technology - Accessories and Shorts/Pants

outcomes.statement: in Stage 4 teachers may adjust the Stage 5 outcomes as appropriate to the needs of students in Years 7 and 8
applies design processes and safe work practices to develop textile projects
communicates ideas, concepts and processes for textile design and production
investigates and evaluates design inspiration sources and textile products
explains industry practices and innovative technologies used in textile design and production
investigates and applies construction and decorative techniques to create textile products
justifies the selection and use of materials and technologies for textile design and production
analyses relationships between textile design, production and sustainability
